protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: the uploads/{id}/download route is guarded only by auth; before the fix, download() passed attacker-controlled id to Media::find() and streamed the result without checking the mediable parent's contact_id. Media's Tenants trait applies the Company global scope, so the demonstrated defect is a same-company portal-customer IDOR, not cross-company access as the CVE text claims.

Earlier Media::find history concerns destroy(), not download().
